presets.label: Bay of Bengal
presets.note: Primary demo region. Freshwater cap and warm-core eddy both fall inside.

presets.label: Andaman Sea
presets.note: Model data but no float or glider ever, in either real catalogue. Useful as a deliberate blind spot; it can never reach the comparison panel.

presets.label: Central Bay of Bengal
presets.note: Deep water throughout - the cleanest volume render.

presets.label: Mozambique Channel
presets.note: The only place in this ocean with glider data. Eight EGO deployments, 2757 dives, ten of the model's twelve months.

presets.label: Arabian Sea
presets.note: Where the monsoon reversal in the surface currents is clearest.
